name: Batch-generate Veo 3.1 videos and Nano Banana Pro images from a Google Sheet

parameters.content:
## Batch-generate Veo 3.1 videos and Nano Banana Pro images from a Google Sheet

### How it works
For marketers and creators who need many images or clips at once, made with Google Flow on your Google AI plan (Plus, Pro or Ultra) through the [useapi.net Google Flow API](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=flow-sheet-batch), a third-party API, not affiliated with Google.

1. Each row is one job: a prompt, a `type` (`image`, `video` or `image+video`) and optional models, aspect ratio and upscale.
2. Run by hand or hourly; rows with an empty `status` are marked `running` with a `job_id`, then run one by one.
3. Nano Banana Pro makes images, Veo 3.1 videos; an `image+video` row can use its image as the first frame.
4. Busy answers (`429`) wait and retry; one failed row never stops the batch.
5. Files go to Google Drive; the row gets `done` or `failed: <reason>` and the links.

Flow credits per 8-second Veo 3.1 video (Google's list): Fast 20 (Ultra 10), Lite 10 (Ultra 5), Quality 100; upscaling is free. Limit: result links expire after about 6 hours, so keep `drive_link`.

### Setup
- [ ] A [useapi.net subscription and API token](https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-useapi?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=flow-sheet-batch), with your Google account connected through [Setup Google Flow](https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-google-flow?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=flow-sheet-batch).
- [ ] A Header Auth credential (Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <your API token>`) on the four useapi.net HTTP nodes.
- [ ] Google Sheets and Drive OAuth2 credentials, and `sheetId` in **Settings**.
- [ ] A tab with these columns in row 1: `prompt`, `video_prompt`, `type`, `image_model`, `video_model`, `aspect_ratio`, `use_image_as_first_frame`, `upscale`, `email`, `status`, `image_url`, `video_url`, `drive_link`, `error`, `job_id`.
- [ ] Click **Run batch now**, or publish for the hourly run.

### Customization
**Settings** holds the defaults (with allowed values), batch size, retries and Drive folder. Clear a `status` to rerun that row.

## Start
Run it by hand, or publish the workflow for an hourly run. One node holds the sheet id and every default.

## Read the sheet and loop
Rows with an empty `status` are marked `running` at once, so overlapping runs never take a row twice, and get a `job_id` that the results are written back by. The cells are checked, then the rows run one at a time.

## Route
The row's `type` picks the first step. A row that failed a check goes straight to the write-back.

## Nano Banana Pro image
One image per row, usually in 10 to 20 seconds. A busy (`429`) or unavailable (`503`) answer waits as the API asks and tries again.

## Veo 3.1 video
Starts an async job, optionally with the row's image as the first frame. A submit that got no answer is never resent, since the job may exist.

## Wait for the job
Checks the video job until it completes or fails, up to a time limit. Google's failure reason goes into the row.

## Upscale to 1080p
Only for rows that ask for it, and free on paid Google AI plans. If it fails, the 720p video is kept and the row says why.

## Save to Google Drive
Downloads the image and the video from their signed links and uploads them to your Drive folder. It can be turned off in Settings.

## Write back
One update per row, matched on its `job_id`, so a sorted sheet still gets each result on the right row: the status, the links and any notes. Then the loop takes the next row.
